prose.en: Tori takes a position at uke's head, lies face down and places his body over uke's upper body. He passes both arms in from outside the points of uke's shoulders, grips both sides of the belt to control uke's arms, spreads both legs wide, and holds uke down by pressing uke's head and chest with his own chest.

Image of the entry and of the hold Tori enters and settles into kami-shiho-gatame. Tori grips both sides of uke's belt with both hands, brings chest to chest, and holds uke down while controlling the upper body.
Uke pushes tori away and twists over onto his front. Uke places both hands on tori's shoulders or on his side, pushes him away and twists his body to turn face down.
Tori comes in from the direction of uke's feet and turns him into the hold. Tori holds uke down while drawing in both sides of the belt from the direction of uke's feet.

heading.en: Faults that are easy to fall into

prose.en: Tori should hold uke down while controlling uke's arms from above.
Uke should not try to escape in a posture that strains the neck or the back.
